characters.name: The Traveler
characters.description: A woman with long wavy brown hair. She wears a bright mustard-yellow rain jacket, a white t-shirt, light blue denim jeans, white sneakers, and carries a matte black backpack. Rendered with loose black ink linework and soft watercolor fills.

locations.name: Dongdaemun Design Plaza, Seoul
locations.description: The curving, metallic-like structure of the plaza rendered in light grey watercolor washes and loose ink outlines. In the background, glowing neon shopfronts shimmer in soft pink and cool blue washes against warm cream paper.

locations.name: Steep Hillside, San Francisco
locations.description: A steep downhill street with a historic cable car in muted brick red and cream watercolor. The background features the San Francisco bay in soft indigo washes under a sunny, warm cream sky.

locations.name: Autumnal Street, Toronto
locations.description: A city street lined with maple trees in faded orange and dry gold watercolor washes. The tall silhouette of the CN Tower rises in soft indigo and grey washes against a clear cream sky.
